title: Check declared replay inputs in offline research exports
body:
A self-consistent bundle receipt can still omit a file declared by its bundled VERIFY.json. Add optional `check --check-inputs` validation for declared input presence, duplicate/canonical paths and undeclared external files. The manifest reread must match the checked payload hash. The command performs no extraction, execution or Git call; default integrity checking remains unchanged.

Use `python3 -B scripts/export_research_package.py check bundle.tar --check-inputs`. The CLI links a guide with the limits and the distinction between declared coverage and full runtime dependency discovery. This PR starts from main and does not depend on PR5728.

Validation: all 32 export tests pass on Python 3.12; the 6 new tests pass under `-O`. Independently constructed coherent archives test missing inputs, extra files, invalid/duplicate declarations, resource bounds and changed manifest bytes. The real optimized CLI passes with Git absent from PATH. `git diff --check` passes.

Fresh main/priorities and live PR/Discussion overlap checked. PR5728 edits separate receipt-type validation. No scientific replay, commit authentication or new κ is claimed. Hosted CI is pending.

Base: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. Verified head: `5e8f76a5e26da67bf8ad7468d2331523793452ad`.

Prepared for aliromman with OpenAI Codex assistance. Existing tool and predecessor credits remain in place. No selected-frontier change.
